---
title: 'Section 6.2 — Test of time-constant effects (footnote 16)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## k = 2

```{r}
t2 <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df             = data,
  outcome        = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group          = "id",
  time           = "time",
  treatment      = "treatment",
  effects        = 2,
  placebo        = 2,
  same_switchers = TRUE,
  effects_equal  = TRUE
)
print(t2)
t2$results$p_equality_effects
```
